title: World Blue: Free International ATM Access
summary: World Blue provides a 0% Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee with a $0.00 minimum for international ATM withdrawals. It automatically rebates foreign ATM operator cash-withdrawal fees up to $100 per calendar month, issued after the withdrawal posts—no enrollment or receipt submission required.
